{{Quote|And you get distracted far too easily. Focus, Ahri, focus."''<br />''"It's just training, Ves."''<br />''"It's ''never'' just training.|Vestara Khai and Ahri Raas|<ref name="Omen" />}}
'''Ahri Raas''' was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. A [[Sith Tyro|Tyro]] in the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]], he [[Sith training|trained]] with the Tribe around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Second Galactic Civil War]]. After taking part in a [[Uvak competition|competition]] to win an [[uvak]], he befriended fellow Tyro [[Vestara Khai]]. Raas and Khai were present when the Tribe first encountered [[Ship (Sith Meditation Sphere)|Ship]], a [[Sith Meditation Sphere]], in [[41 ABY]]. In [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]], shortly after [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] presence was felt by the Tribe, Ship abruptly left Kesh. By this time, Raas had been [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprenticed]] to [[Sith Master/Legends|Sith Master]] [[Yuvar Xal]].

Raas and Xal were chosen as members of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith strike team|strike team]] sent to recover Ship and [[Death/Legends|kill]] Skywalker. Aboard the ''[[Eternal Crusader]]'', they tracked Ship to a [[Abeloth's planet|planet]] in [[Maw Cluster/Legends|the Maw]], where they met [[Abeloth]], a mysterious woman who pretended to befriend and assist the Sith. Still, the strike team suffered heavy losses, and Xal planned to initiate a coup against the team's leader, [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lady]] [[Olaris Rhea|Rhea]]. Before the betrayal could be executed, however, Ship returned to the Sith and transported them to [[Sinkhole Station]], a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in the Maw. There, they [[Skirmish at Sinkhole Station|ambushed]] Skywalker and his son, [[Ben Skywalker|Ben]]. Xal, however, had ordered Raas to kill Khai as part of his coup against Rhea. When Khai threw her [[Grenade/Legends|grenades]] at the Skywalkers, Raas [[Telekinesis/Legends|pushed]] them back at her. Rhea, however, had anticipated his betrayal and had given Khai false grenades to throw first. As Raas attempted to apprehend a seemingly stunned Ben Skywalker, Khai killed Xal. Raas, distracted by his Master's cry of surprise and pain, was quickly killed by a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] strike from Ben, unaffected by the stun grenade.

==Biography==
===Early life===
{{Quote|Ves, that's&hellip;is that a ''ship''?|Raas, upon first seeing a Sith Meditation Sphere|<ref name="Omen" />}}
Ahri Raas was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] and [[Sith Tyro]]. He [[Sith training|trained]] with the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]]&mdash;descendants of a group of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] whose [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the ''[[Omen]]'', had crash-landed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]] around [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], while attempting to transport [[Lignan crystal]]s to [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]] during the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]]. Raas, who was a member of the planet's native [[Species/Legends|species]] rather than a direct descendant of the surviving [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], was born on Kesh around [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]].<ref name="Omen" />

[[File:VestaraKhai-FOTJPoster.jpg|thumb|right|175px|Ahri Raas' friend Vestara Khai]]
Raas began training with the Tribe in the ways of the Sith, and, in [[37 ABY]], he took place in a [[Uvak competition|competition]] held among the youth of the Tribe to obtain a personal [[uvak]]&mdash;winged [[Reptile/Legends|reptilian]] creatures native to Kesh&mdash;by imposing their will on unhatched creatures through the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] so that it would "imprint" upon the competitor. Raas and the [[Human/Legends|Human]] Tyro [[Vestara Khai]] picked the [[Tikk|same uvak]], and, after a battle of wills, Khai eventually won.<ref name="Imprint">"[[Imprint]]"</ref> Raas later became a close friend of Khai, whom he often trained with in [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|combat]].<ref name="Omen" />

In [[41 ABY]], after one such training session, they saw a [[Ship (Sith Meditation Sphere)|ship]] fly over them, toward the ruins of the ''Omen''&mdash;which had become known as the Ship of Destiny&mdash;in the [[Kesh Sith Temple|Sith Temple]]. Khai called her [[uvak]], [[Tikk]], and she and Raas took the creature to find the ship. They found the [[Sith Meditation Sphere|spherical vessel]] in the middle of the [[Temple courtyard]], where many Sith had already gathered, and the ship began to speak to Khai through [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. The Tribe, having finally acquired a way to leave the planet, began to use the ship to attack and capture [[Starship/Legends|starships]] to form an [[Sith armada (Lost Tribe of the Sith)|armada]]. In [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]], [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] touched an [[Aing-Tii/Legends|Aing-Tii]] [[Relics|relic]], the [[Codex]], sending out a call through the Force which alerted the Tribe to the threat he presented. Shortly afterward, Ship abruptly departed the planet of Kesh. By that time, Raas had been taken as an [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] under the [[Sith Master/Legends|Sith Master]] [[Yuvar Xal]].<ref name="Omen" />

===Strike team===
{{Quote|Tell me, why do ''you'' think Ship would go to such lengths to make sure we could follow it? Why do you think it would have picked ''that'' place to let us find it again?''"<br />"''Because Vestara's wrong. It ''is'' leading us into a trap.|Rhea and Raas|<ref name="Abyss" />}}
Xal and Raas were chosen to be a part of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith strike team|strike team]] whose task was to recover Ship and return it to Kesh, and hunt down and kill Skywalker. The team, aboard the [[Warship/Legends|warship]] ''[[Eternal Crusader]]'', followed Ship, using Khai's unique connection to the Meditation Sphere to track it. This caused some unrest among the crew, and the Sith debated why it would allow Khai to track it, as well as what it was doing to begin with. Raas suggested that it was leading them into a trap, and, though Lady [[Olaris Rhea]], the strike team's leader, agreed, she decided that they had to follow it anyway. They tracked it to a [[Abeloth's planet|planet]] in [[Maw Cluster/Legends|the Maw]], where Raas and Xal were chosen by Rhea to be a part of the search party sent down to the planet to find Ship. On the planet they met [[Abeloth]], a powerful being who pretended to help the Tribe, while actually sabotaging their efforts to escape with Ship. Meanwhile, Raas was tasked by Xal with getting closer to Khai and gaining her trust in order to stage a coup against Rhea, so Xal could take over the strike team's leadership.<ref name="Abyss" />

[[File:LukeExile-Outcast.jpg|thumb|left|225px|Luke Skywalker, quarry of the Sith strike team]]
As the search continued without success, Rhea finally decided that they should just leave without Ship, and Xal decided that it was time to execute his coup. Before either of these could happen, however, the Meditation Sphere suddenly reappeared. As the search party took up pursuit, Rhea was attacked by a [[siphon reed]] and pulled into a whirlpool. Khai jumped in to save her master, and as they resurfaced, Raas [[Telekinesis/Legends|grasped]] them in the Force to bring them safely to shore. The search went on fruitlessly, and several more Sith arrived on [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttles]] from the ''Eternal Crusader'' to join the search party until there were no crew members left aboard the ship. Eventually, however, Abeloth discovered Skywalkers location, and allowed Ship to return to the Sith. The strike team left to kill Luke Skywalker and his son, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Ben Skywalker]], in [[Sinkhole Station]], a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in the Maw.<ref name="Abyss" />

There, Raas, Xal, Khai, and [[Sith Saber]] [[Baad Walusari]] were set up at a juntion in the station which the Skywalkers would have to pass in order to get to their ship in the station's [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]]. They were commanded to [[Skirmish at Sinkhole Station|ambush]] the Skywalkers with [[Grenade/Legends|grenades]], but Raas was ordered by Xal to betray his friend and Force push her grenades back at her when she threw them at the Skywalkers. When the Jedi arrived on the scene after escaping from their first confrontation with members of the strike team, Khai and Walusari threw their grenades at them, and Raas and Xal quickly pushed the explosives back at the two Sith as they threw their own [[Stun grenade/Legends|stun grenades]]. Rhea, however, had expected treachery, and had provided Khai with fake grenades. Meanwhile, the Skywalkers pretended to have been knocked unconscious, and Raas prepared to restrain the younger Jedi. Upset by Raas' betrayal, Khai threw her [[shikkar]] at Xal, killing him. Raas was distracted by his master's cry of shock and anguish, and was quickly killed, sliced down the spine by the lightsaber of Ben Skywalker, when Ahri had been attempting to subdue him.<ref name="Abyss" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Ves, you all right?|Ahri Raas|<ref name="Omen" />}}
Ahri Raas had a somewhat relaxed outlook on life, and was not as competitive or ambitious as his friend, Vestara Khai. He was also rather compassionate, and cared deeply about Khai; however, Khai shared no romantic feelings for him.<ref name="Omen" /> He wasn't afraid to speak out among higher-ranking Sith, as he offered his theory to Rhea as to why Ship was allowing only Khai to track it. Later, Raas was troubled by Xal's orders to gain Khai's trust in order to betray her. However, he was loyal to his master, and carried out his commands, betraying Khai and attempting to kill her when the time came.<ref name="Abyss" />

==Powers and abilities==
{{Quote|Blast. You're getting good, Ahri."''<br />''"I'd say the same about you, Ves, except for the fact that that sand-jump messes you up every single ti&mdash;|Khai and Raas, during a training session|<ref name="Omen" />}}
Raas often trained in lightsaber combat and frequently and effectively used telekinesis techniques. He was not as accomplished in these areas as Khai, however, and he lacked the necessary focus, causing him to fall prey to Khai's use of [[Dun Möch/Legends|Dun Möch]].<ref name="Omen" /> During the battle with the Skywalkers, he and his master underestimated the Jedi, believing incorrectly that stun grenades could incapacitate them. Raas was distracted by Xal's cry of pain as the Sith Master was killed, resulting in his own death.<ref name="Abyss" /> Raas had [[Color/Legends|white]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]], red [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and pale purple skin.<ref name="Omen" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ahri Raas was created as a minor character by author [[Christie Golden]] for ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Omen]]'', her debut ''[[Star Wars]]'' novel and the second volume in the nine-part [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series.
